title: Jamie Davis (Louisiana)
intro:
Jamie Davis (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Louisiana. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary runoff on June 27, 2026.
Davis completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
